notes.title: Use time itself as a weapon in new roguelike Panta Rhei, which you can play now
notes.notes:
I was a little late to the roguelike genre, only fully understanding the impetus to play the same levels over and over again when Hades span a narrative thread through my runs in 2020. Since then, I've immersed myself in the classics of the genre, as well as the roguelite subgenre. I've put numerous hours into FTL, Into the Breach, and Slay the Spire, and found many more gems besides. And it's in the wake of these lesser known indies like Blue Prince and Ravenswatch (the latter the best Hades clone to date) that Panta Rhei emerges. Full of charm and with a time-bending twist, it looks right up my street.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The time has come!
notes.notes: [p]It is done, after years of hard work the time has finally come - Panta Rhei is out on PC and ready for you to play! What started as a university prototype went all the way to becoming a (somewhat) professional Indie title, and we are super proud of what we achieved. For many in the team this was the first experience in developing and publishing a full game, and I am grateful to all our partners, mentors and collaborators that I got to meet along the way.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for spending your precious time with us![/p][p][/p][p]See you in the Realm of Time,[/p][p]Raff[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="xcS-A0mufaw;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo available now!
notes.notes:
The new demo for Panta Rhei is now publicly available for everyone! We are excited to share this first real glimpse into the Realm of Time and are eagerly awaiting your feedback over on discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42475669/8f67a73323e00e99589158462d86f671d8c89ec2.png[/img]

The demo is set in the first area of the game, The Garden of Past, and focuses on the core combat and exploration game loop. It features two of the main time abilities, Timestepping and Timeshaping, allowing Phi to control time for themselves and the environment.

We will continuously update this demo with fixes, features and content updates in the coming months so be sure to wishlist the game and stay in touch!

Wishing you the best of times,
The team at reignite games

notes.title: May Playtesting Release
notes.notes:
The May Release brings some major changes to the public playtesting build, featuring the current state of the reversion mechanic and a new vision for the visual direction of the Garden of Past.

Updates:
- New vertical slice demo set in the Garden of Past
- Completely reworked map generation system
- Integrated a new environment reversion mechanic
- Integrated first puzzles utilising reversion
- Added the playable prototype the new minion enemy

notes.title: Easter Special
notes.notes:
Happy easter every-bunny!

The easter special update introduces a little side-quest into the pre-alpha playtesting build. Eggbert got separated from his family and now it's up to you to find all of them scattered across the garden!
